title: HQ Systems Administrator
desc:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented HQ Systems Administrator to join our team in Doral, FL.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise server hardware, operating systems, and virtualized infrastructure across headquarters systems.
Managing user accounts, system permissions, Active Directory structures, and group policies across enterprise networks.
Performing routine system maintenance, vulnerability patching, software updates, and diagnostic evaluations to ensure security compliance.
Monitoring system performance, storage availability, and network services to proactively resolve operational bottlenecks.
Collaborating with cross-functional technical teams, network engineers, and leadership to maintain high system availability.
Maintaining accurate configuration management records, technical system documentation, and operational baseline inventories.
Recommending and implementing continuous process improvements to streamline IT administration and enterprise system efficiency.


Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related field with 5+ years of experience in systems administration.
OR a master’s degree and 3+ or more years of relevant experience
OR an associate’s degree and 7+ or more years of relevant experience
OR a high school diploma and 9+ or more years of relevant experience
Proven experience administering Windows and Linux server operating systems, Active Directory, and virtualized enterprise environments.
Hands-on experience with system patch management, baseline configuration management, and server hardware maintenance.
Proficiency in troubleshooting hardware, software, network services, and system access issues.
Experience creating, maintaining, and communicating complex information technology documentation and system baselines.

Preferred Qualifications

Relevant professional certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, or VMware Certified Professional (VCP).
Prior experience supporting U.S. Military Command operations, Combatant Command environments, or Department of Defense enterprise technical environments.
Familiarity with DoD STIG implementation, vulnerability scanning tools (ACAS), and secure baseline auditing procedures.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across multi-disciplinary engineering teams in fast-paced operational environments.


Clearance Requirements

Must hold a current/active top secret security clearance.


Physical Requirements

Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%.
Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.
Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

title: Enterprise Systems Administrator
desc:
Greenberg Traurig (GT), a global law firm with locations across the world in 15 countries, has an exciting employment opportunity for you. We offer competitive compensation and an excellent benefits package, along with the opportunity to work within an innovative and collaborative environment.

Join our Technology Team as an Enterprise Systems Administrator located in various offices.

We are seeking a professional who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. The ideal candidate possesses strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in every task. With a dedicated work ethic and a can-do attitude, you will take initiative and approach challenges with confidence and resilience. Excellent communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively across teams and delivering exceptional client service. If you are someone who demonstrates initiative, adaptability, and innovation, we invite you to join our team.

This role can be based in various offices, on a hybrid basis. This role reports to the Enterprise Monitoring and Systems Management Supervisor.

Position Summary

The Enterprise Systems Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day management, monitoring, security, and support of the firm’s enterprise servers, applications, and cloud platforms. This role ensures the stability, security, and optimal performance of all enterprise infrastructure, with a focus on Microsoft technologies. The administrator proactively monitors system health, troubleshoots and resolves technical issues, investigates and remediates security incidents, and maintains the integrity of the server environment with regular security updates and patches. The position requires strong analytical skills and deep technical knowledge. This role also requires individuals who are trustworthy, reliable, and uphold strict ethical standards in all professional dealings. Flexibility to work non-standard hours and participate in on-call rotation is required.

Key Responsibilities

Manages, monitors, and supports Microsoft Windows operating systems, software applications, and related infrastructure services across the on-premises infrastructure and cloud platforms
Maintains regular server and application security updates and patches to mitigate vulnerabilities and enhance system performance, following established server patch management processes and procedures
Monitors and analyzes performance, availability, and security alerts for servers, applications, and services, using various tools and methods, such as dashboards, alerts, reports, logs, etc.
Conducts regular health and security checks on servers and related infrastructure services and implements security best practices and recommendations
Configures and maintains security settings, access rights, and related controls to prevent unauthorized access, data loss, and other security threats
Administers and supports Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) infrastructure, Active Directory Domain Services, and Microsoft Entra ID
Administers and maintains monitoring with Microsoft System Center Operations Manager (SCOM) while integrating Azure Monitor and Log Analytics workspace
Provides Tier 3 technical support, root cause analysis, and guidance for IT infrastructure, application, and security and monitoring-related issues
Identifies and responds to security incidents and threats, following the incident response plan and procedures, and coordinates with other IT staff and external parties as needed
Develops and maintains automation scripts to automate administrative and routine tasks
Supports project delivery and execution of tasks related to areas of team Collaborates with information security and compliance teams to ensure compliance with industry standards
Stays current with emerging trends and best practices in infrastructure optimization and modernization, endpoint protection, identity management, cloud security, and AI model security
Maintains standard operating procedures and configuration documentation for infrastructure systems and processes


Qualifications

Skills & Competencies 

Strong expertise in Microsoft Windows operating systems
Good working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure
In-depth knowledge of AD DS, Entra ID, DFS, ADFS, and LDAP
Strong understanding of identity and access management and role-based access control concepts
Working knowledge of SQL, IIS and SharePoint troubleshooting
Good working knowledge of identity federation and multifactor authentication management
Solid understanding of authentication and authorization flows
Solid working knowledge of basic networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP
Strong knowledge in monitoring and security tooling, such as antivirus, endpoint protection, identity protection, data loss prevention, application-based firewalls, SIEM, etc.
Solid understanding and familiarity with Linux and MacOS systems preferred
Solid scripting skills in PowerShell; experience with other scripting/programming languages is preferred
API programming skills are preferred
Basic understanding of AI model infrastructure security is preferred
Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve system, application, security, and performance issues
Strong communication, interpersonal, and cross-functional collaboration skills
Ability to articulate issues, risks, and proposed solutions to various levels of technology staff, management, and non-technical audiences
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to document and maintain security and monitoring policies, procedures, and configurations
Ability to multitask efficiently yet prioritize and organize competing work demands
Demonstrated integrity and commitment to strict ethical standards in all professional dealings
Proven record of reliability and dependability
Candidate must be a self-starter and independent, yet function as an integral part of a team
Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, and security-conscious environment
Candidate must demonstrate a high degree of initiative and motivation
Ability to work flexible hours and be on-call


Education & Prior Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent work experience
5+ years of professional experience managing medium-to-large enterprise Microsoft Windows environments, preferably in a law firm or professional services environment
5+ years of experience in systems administration, or similar technical roles
Strong experience with Microsoft Windows Server 2012-2025 and Windows 11
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, and GCP
Hands-on experience with Systems Center Operations Manager (SCOM) and System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM)
Solid experience managing all aspects of Active Directory Domain Services
Proven troubleshooting and technical issue resolution experience
Experience with WMI, Syslog, and Performance Monitor
Relevant Microsoft certifications: Azure Security Engineer Associate and Identity and Access Administrator Associate, or equivalent are preferred


GT is an EEO employer with an inclusive workplace committed to merit-based consideration and review without regard to an individual’s race, sex, or other protected characteristics and to the principles of non-discrimination on any protected basis.

title: Administrator, Technology II
desc:
Summary

AAR Airframe MRO – Miami, an industry-leading provider of aircraft maintenance, repair , and overhaul services and a supplier of airframe and engine parts, is seeking a Technology Administrator II to join our dynamic IT team . This hands-on role supports employees in both office and active hangar environments by resolving day -to- day hardware, software, access , application, and connectivity issues. The administrator will independently handle routine break/fix support and systems administration, support our industry-leading Paperless Taskcard Solution, contribute to technology improvements , and escalate complex issues when appropriate . Experience using approved AI- enabled tools to improve troubleshooting, documentation, and operational efficiency is valued .

AAR offers competitive pay, and a comprehensive benefit package. AAR is an equal opportunity employer and recognizes the value of a diverse workforce.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

 Provide responsive technical support to employees in office and hangar environments , diagnosing and resolving common hardware, software, account , application, printing, mobile- device , and connectivity issues. 
 Administer and maintain assigned technologies, including Windows systems , Microsoft 365 services, endpoints , identity and access tools , and virtualized resources , following established standards and seeking guidance for complex changes. 
 Perform regular system updates, patches, and configurations to enhance system reliability and security. 
 Support AAR’s industry-leading Paperless Taskcard Solution and other business- critical applications by assisting users , triaging incidents, documenting findings , coordinating with application owners and vendors , and escalating issues when needed . 
 Monitor system performance and proactively address issues to minimize downtime. 
 Monitor and maintain backup and recovery solutions for assigned systems and applications, perform routine recovery checks, and promptly escalate failures or risks . 
 Diagnose and resolve break/fix incidents involving hardware, software, business applications, and network connectivity within established service expectations; communicate status to users , document actions taken , and escalate complex issues appropriately . 
 Create and maintain accurate support documentation, knowledge articles, system configurations, troubleshooting steps , and operational procedures ; use approved AI- enabled tools when appropriate and validate all generated content before use. 
 Use approved AI- enabled tools to assist with troubleshooting, summarize technical information, identify recurring support patterns, draft documentation, and improve routine workflows while following company security , privacy , and data-handling requirements . 
 Actively participate in company’s Safety Management System (SMS) including reporting safety hazards and incidents encountered in daily operations; understand and promote the company safety policy. 
 Ensure security, compliance, privacy, and best practices are being adhered to as required. 
 Perform all other duties as directed. 


Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Technology, or related field. 
 Two to four years of experience providing end-user support and administering business technology in a Windows- based environment . Experience in manufacturing , maintenance, aviation, or another operationally dynamic environment is a plus. 
 Working knowledge of Windows endpoints and servers, identity and access management, Microsoft 365, networking fundamentals , and common IT support tools , with the ability to troubleshoot routine issues independently . 
 Hands-on experience supporting Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Entra Connect , Microsoft 365, cloud services, and business applications, including routine account administration, incident triage, and user assistance. 
 Working knowledge of Power Automate, PowerShell, Python, or similar tools for routine automation, along with experience using approved AI-assisted tools to support troubleshooting, draft or review scripts, summarize information, and improve productivity. 
 Familiarity with storage solutions and networking protocols. 
 Strong customer -service, problem-solving , and communication skills , including the ability to explain technical issues clearly , remain responsive in a fast- paced environment , and recognize when escalation is required . 
 Relevant certifications (e.g., MCSE, VCP) are a plus. 


Requirements

 Commitment to company values and ethics 
 Dependability: personally responsible, completes work in a timely manner, and performs tasks accurately. 
 Motivation: must maintain a positive attitude and strong work energy 
 Communication: excellent interpersonal and oral and written communication skills 
 Organization: very detail oriented and always comes prepared 
 Initiative: plans work and carries out tasks without detailed instructions, prepares for problems or opportunities in advance, undertakes additional responsibilities 
 Teamwork: Collaborate effectively with local employees, operations teams, application owners, vendors, and the broader IT organization. Participate as an active member of the wider IT community supporting other MRO locations across the Americas and the corporation’s operations globally; share and absorb knowledge and provide guidance to less-experienced team members when appropriate. 


Physical Demands/Work Environment

 The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 
 While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required to sit, stand, bend, reach and move about the facility. The environmental characteristic for this position is both an office setting and active hangar floor. Candidates should be able to adapt to a traditional business environment. 


If you are a customer-focused technology professional who enjoys solving problems in a fast- paced aerospace environment , we invite you to apply . Join us in supporting our employees , our Paperless Taskcard Solution, and the reliable technology services that help keep maintenance operations moving .

title: Senior IT Systems Administrator [649]
desc:
D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) D-Wave is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. We are the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the only company building both annealing and gate-model quantum computers. Our mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum, today. Our 5,000+ qubit AdvantageTM quantum computers, the world’s largest, are available on-premises or via the cloud, supported by 99.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations trust D-Wave with their toughest computational challenges. With over 200 million problems submitted to our Advantage and Advantage2TM systems to date, our customers apply our technology to address use cases spanning optimization, artificial intelligence, research and more. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how we’re shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: www.dwavequantum.com.

About The Role

The main goal of the D-Wave IT team is to provide top notch infrastructure and support service to all of D-Wave. In this role, you’ll be working with our team to design and maintain our core IT Infrastructure services, including our network, security systems, telephony services and backup environments. You’ll also help support our users with OS specific issues directly and provide network and security support across the entire company IT infrastructure, both local and remote. You’ll be expected to improve how we operate, strengthen the technical capabilities of the team, reduce recurring issues, and take increasing ownership of infrastructure decisions and projects. International travel requirement 25% annually to support conferences and events.

This role is open to candidates in Florida. However, a hybrid work structure at our Head Office in Boca Raton is preferred.

What You'll Do

 Architect, deploy, proactively monitor and maintain our company infrastructure so it is modern, secure, up to date, and meets the changing needs of our internal customers 
Manage our core and endpoint security related systems and tools such as our Firewalls, IDS, MDM solution, antivirus software and central encryption management products
Maintain and administer Atlassian Suite, support the use of various Ai tools such as Claude, Chat GPT, Fellow etc.
Maintain and develop existing Enterprise IT services such as: AD/LDAP, Centrify, RSA, Microsoft O365 etc.
Help define, implement, maintain and monitor hardware, services, security and network devices
Assist our internal helpdesk with security, communications and OS related issues (Windows/OSX/Linux)
Support, troubleshoot and optimize the performance of enterprise and development computing systems
Provide tier 2 support for internal and external customers
Occasionally assist L1 support with hands-on troubleshooting and fixes, including installing and upgrading software, installing hardware, implementing file backups, and configuring systems and applications
Work with the DevOps team on maintaining connection points to AWS and inject your skills around Kubernetes, Chef and Terraform to assist in development and infrastructure needs
Develop scripts and automation to optimize workflow efficiency


About You

Bachelor’s degree; or a post-secondary diploma
5+ years' experience in IT security, hardware, and networking, with hands-on experience equivalent to or exceeding the CCNA certification.
Expertise in configuring and maintaining Microsoft infrastructure, including Active Directory (AD), Intune, and Entra ID.
Proven ability in developing and maintaining IP networks, including both the physical and logical design of LANs and VPNs, encompassing VLAN configuration, subnetting, access control, wireless network setup, and remote site connectivity.
Proficient in managing content management systems such as Atlassian and SharePoint.
Experienced in working with cloud infrastructure services, including AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Azure.
In-depth expertise with the XCP-ng hypervisor, including deployment, configuration, and maintenance.


A D-Waver's DNA

We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We show the way ahead and are committed to achieving ambitious goals.
We practice straight talk and listen generously to each other with empathy. We value different opinions and points of views. We ensure that we connect outside as well as inside to learn from others and inspire each other.
We hold ourselves accountable for delivering results. We make decisions & take responsibility so that we can act & support each other.
As leaders we motivate & engage our teams to undertake beyond what they originally thought possible, by developing our teams & creating the conditions for people to grow and empower themselves through enabling & coaching.


Our Compensation Philosophy Is Simple But Powerful

We believe providing D-Wavers with company ownership, competitive pay, and a range of meaningful benefits is the start of creating a culture where people want to give the best they’ve got — not because they’re simply making money, but because they’ve fallen in love with our vision, mission, values, and team.

During the interview process, your Recruiter will review our total rewards (base, equity, bonus, perks, benefit, culture) . The final offer is determined by your proficiencies within this level. 

Inclusion

We celebrate diverse perspectives to drive innovation in our pursuit. Our employees range from distinguished domain experts with decades of experience in their respective fields, to bright and motivated graduates eager to make their mark. Our diverse and innovative team will make you feel appreciated, supported and empower your career growth at D-Wave.

The Fine Print

No 3rd party candidates will be accepted

It is D-Wave policy to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, local law.

Job seekers should be aware of fraudulent job offers from online scammers and only apply to roles listed on D-Wave Careers site using our applicant system. Note: We do not use text messaging or third-party messaging apps to communicate with applicants and will never ask for fees or financial commitment, so please exercise caution if you are approached in this way. Authentic communications will come from an @dwavesys.com email.

 

For more information, please read our full Statement Regarding Job Recruiting Fraud Scams.

The Pay Range For This Role Is

113,000 - 156,000 USD per year(FL)

title: Technical Operations Administrator
desc:
For over 35 years, Peak Technologies has been at the forefront of providing end-to-end enterprise mobility, managed services, printing and mobile data capture solutions for performance-driven organizations focused on the optimization of supply chain and field-based business processes.

Job Site: 1500 NW 95th Ave, Doral, FL.
Salary: $72,500 annually.
Classification: Full-time, exempt (salaried).
Schedule: Mon-Fri 8-5/9-6.
Language Requirements: Bilingual English/Spanish required.


Job Summary & Scope

Responsible for the daily administration, maintenance, and optimization of the organization’s IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, storage, and cloud resources. This role ensures high availability, security, and compliance, while supporting user access, patch management, backup, and disaster recovery. The administrator collaborates closely with engineers, analysts, vendors, and business units to deliver reliable and secure IT services.

Key Accountabilities

Administer and maintain physical and virtual servers (Windows, Linux), storage systems, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Configure, monitor, and maintain network devices (routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs) to ensure secure and efficient connectivity.
Implement and optimize backup, restore, and disaster recovery processes.
Apply patches, updates, and configuration changes following change management protocols.
Manage user access, permissions, and security groups in accordance with company policies.
Review and update system configurations for compliance and performance.
Enforce security policies, access controls, and compliance standards (e.g., ISO 27001).
Conduct and support vulnerability scanning, remediation, and compliance audits in collaboration with SecOps.
Maintain comprehensive documentation for systems, configurations, access controls, and operational procedures.
Monitor infrastructure alerts, respond to incidents, and provide Tier 1/2 support for complex technical issues.
Participate in incident investigations, root-cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions.
Assist in post-incident reviews and the development of preventive measures.

Collaborate with enterprise IT teams to address operational requirements and resolve cross-functional technical issues.

Support infrastructure projects and initiatives designed to improve the efficiency, capability, reliability, or security of the environment.
Evaluate vendor products and technical solutions to develop functional requirements for system enhancements and changes.
Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams to design and implement infrastructure solutions aligned with command requirements.
Produce technical data sets, reports, and informational materials for management in support of operational visibility and process improvement efforts.

Review, develop, and maintain technical documentation covering system configurations, testing, administrative procedures, troubleshooting guides, and operational processes.
Document system changes, configurations, Group Policy implementations, automation processes, and technical best practices.
Provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and mentorship to junior administrators and other team members.
Promote a strong foundational understanding of the systems and services supporting organizational operations.


Required Qualifications
Active U.S. Government Secret security clearance is required.
Applicable DoD 8140 or DoD 8570 certification.
Demonstrated proficiency in PowerShell scripting and the automation of repetitive systems administration tasks.
Proven experience in systems administration and enterprise infrastructure management.
Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server and Active Directory environments.

Experience developing, implementing, and administering Group Policy, including policies supporting resource management and security vulnerability remediation.
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex server, infrastructure, performance, security, and availability issues.
Ability to review, modify, and develop comprehensive technical documentation, including system configurations, troubleshooting guides, procedures, and best practices.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Experience supporting USCENTCOM and familiarity with its mission.
Knowledge of and familiarity with USCENTCOM’s IT environment.
Experience working on cross-functional IT teams and technical projects.

Overview

The Systems Analyst & Database Administrator is responsible for administering, monitoring, supporting, and continuously improving the Bank’s on-premises and cloud database environments. The position serves as a primary technical resource for database availability, performance, capacity, security, patching, backup, recovery, production support, and service restoration across business-critical data platforms.

The role also administers and supports the Power BI environment and Gateway infrastructure, including data source connections, credentials, configuration changes, refresh connectivity, platform monitoring, and technical support required for successful report deployments. The position works closely with Data Operations, Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Information Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, application support teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to resolve operational issues, implement changes, improve early-warning capabilities, and ensure reliable delivery of enterprise data services.

The incumbent applies systems-analysis techniques to evaluate operational requirements, troubleshoot complex technical issues, document solutions, and identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, modernize legacy components, and improve operational resiliency.

Supports database security, access management, data protection controls, and compliance with applicable security, privacy, and regulatory requirements. 
Evaluates database technologies, administration tools, monitoring platforms, vendor solutions, and automation opportunities that improve operational effectiveness and reliability. 
Participates in integration and orchestration improvements intended to reduce repetitive work, modernize legacy processing, and improve detection and recovery when processes fail. 
Participates in on-call, after-hours, weekend, holiday, maintenance, and recovery activities as required to support critical enterprise data services.

title: Lead Analyst, Service Desk
desc:
Firm Overview

H.I.G. Capital is a leading global private equity investment firm with $75 billion of assets under management with a focus on the mid cap segment of the market. The H.I.G. family of funds includes private equity, growth equity, real estate, direct lending, special situation credit, and growth-stage healthcare. We focus on providing capital to businesses with attractive growth potential and align ourselves with committed management teams and entrepreneurs to help grow businesses of significant value. Our team of over 500 investment professionals has substantial operating, consulting, technology, and financial management experience, enabling us to contribute meaningfully to our portfolio companies. H.I.G. is based in Miami, with offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, New York, and San Francisco, and affiliate offices in Hamburg, London, Luxembourg, Madrid, Milan, and Paris in Europe as well as Bogotá, Rio de Janeiro, and São Paulo in Latin America, Dubai in the Middle East, and Hong Kong in Asia.

Role Overview

H.I.G. Capital is seeking a Lead Analyst, Service Desk, to oversee day-to-day operations of the Service Desk team and provide expert-level technical support across the firm. This role is ideal for a highly experienced IT professional with strong leadership skills, capable of managing complex issues, driving process improvements, and mentoring a team of analysts. This is a 100% onsite role, requiring an annual rotation between our Coral Gables, Florida and Miami/Brickell, Florida offices.

The Lead Analyst will act as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues, supports IT management in driving service improvements, and mentors Service Desk analysts to elevate technical capability and service quality. This is a hands-on role requiring deep technical expertise, strong communication skills, and the ability to lead through influence rather than direct management authority.

Role Responsibilities

Lead and mentor the Service Desk team, including Junior Analysts and IT Interns, fostering technical skill development and professional growth.
Serve as the primary escalation point for complex Tier 2-3 incidents across hardware, software, mobile devices, enterprise applications, and network systems.
Oversee day-to-day operations of the Service Desk, ensuring timely incident resolution and adherence to service level agreements (SLAs).
Collaborate with IT management to develop, implement, and improve IT support processes and procedures.
Provide strategic input on IT initiatives, system upgrades, and new technology deployments to enhance productivity and security.
Maintain and manage IT assets, including imaging, configuration, and lifecycle management, ensuring accuracy of inventory and compliance with policies.
Monitor enterprise IT systems, including endpoint security solutions, network devices, and alerting/monitoring tools, proactively addressing potential issues.
Work closely with internal teams and business stakeholders to provide enhanced support for key leaders and high-priority initiatives.
Document and maintain knowledge base articles, service desk procedures, and escalation protocols to ensure knowledge continuity.
Participate in vendor management, liaising with external support organizations as necessary for complex technical issues.


Requirements & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field: or a high school diploma with equivalent work experience.
5+ years of hands-on Service Desk or IT support experience in enterprise environments, including leadership or supervisory experience.
Expert-level knowledge of Microsoft Windows 10/11, Office 365/Microsoft 365, SCCM, Intune, and enterprise desktop support.
Strong expertise in Windows Server OS, VMware, networking, Cisco/Fortinet devices, firewalls, and endpoint security solutions.
Experience with monitoring and alerting tools such as PRTG, LogicMonitor, or similar.
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop IT teams, balancing hands-on support with leadership responsibilities.
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with ability to convey technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize multiple competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to handle confidential information and act with discretion.
Certifications preferred: CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), and Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).
Physical ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 25 lbs.

title: IT Support Engineer I, Operations Infrastructure Services (OIS)
desc:
Description

Job Summary

We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled Field Engineer to join our Infrastructure Reliability Programs (IRP) team within Operational Infrastructure Services (OIS). In this role, you will support mission-critical network infrastructure projects across Amazon fulfillment centers, ensuring reliable and secure operations. You will work cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and program teams to execute infrastructure deployments and migrations in a fast-paced environment.

Program Specifics

Move Off Corp (MOC) is an S-team goal and multi-year Stores cross-cutting mandate to remove Amazon's Corporate (CORP) network's security, availability, and scalability risks from all current and future Operations (Ops) buildings and enable Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) to reduce login impersonations threats (FAQ 1). After successfully externalizing all Greenfield site types in 2022-25, the MOC program shifted in 2025 to complete the removal of the CORP network in all Brownfield sites by the end of 2027.

While this job is currently showing out of MIA1, this job can be filled out of any site. Travel up to 75% of the time is expected during the peak of the program.

Key job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

 Execute network infrastructure installations, configurations, and migrations across fulfillment center environments
 Perform hands-on troubleshooting and resolution of network hardware and connectivity issues
 Support site infrastructure assessments, site walks, and readiness reviews
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Operations, Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME), and regional engineering teams to ensure seamless project execution
 Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and contribute to continuous improvement of deployment and migration processes
 Document project progress, site conditions, and technical findings accurately and in a timely manner
 Support the commissioning and decommissioning of network equipment as part of site lifecycle activities
 Participate in change management processes, including MCM creation, review, and execution
 Travel to fulfillment center sites as required to support project timelines and deliverables
 Adhere to all safety protocols and Amazon operational standards while working in warehouse environments


Basic Qualifications

 1+ years of Windows Server technologies: AD, DFS, Print Services, SCCM experience
 2+ years of troubleshooting in a multi-user high availability environment experience
 2+ years of PC repair, troubleshooting, deployment and liquidation experience
 1+ years of IT client, server, and network service delivery experience
 2+ years of networking (such as DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI Model, and TCP/IP) experience
 2+ years of corporate setting Windows, Mac or Linux Operating systems support experience

title: LTG - Sr Systems Engineer
desc:
Job Description

We are Lennar

Lennar is one of the nation’s leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.

A Career that Empowers You to Build Your Future

The Senior Endpoint Engineer leads the planning, implementation, administration, and support of enterprise endpoint management systems and virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) serving over 12,000 geographically distributed endpoints across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and other devices. The role serves as a technical leader, mentor, and subject matter expert, ensuring secure, well-managed, and high-performing endpoints across the enterprise.

Your Responsibilities On The Team

Endpoint Engineering & Management


Administer and optimize Microsoft Intune for modern device management across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android, including enrollment, configuration and compliance policies, app deployment, and Windows Autopilot zero-touch provisioning at scale. 
Manage Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) environments, including Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Citrix, or VMware Horizon, ensuring high availability, performance, and a consistent user experience for remote and hybrid workers. 
Develop and maintain endpoint security baselines, CIS benchmarks, and hardening standards, partnering with security and infrastructure teams to enforce Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker encryption, and data loss prevention (DLP) policies. 
Oversee endpoint patching and software update management using Intune, MECM/SCCM, or equivalent tooling, ensuring timely remediation of vulnerabilities across the fleet. 
Manage application packaging, deployment, and lifecycle for enterprise endpoint software, including scripting and automation using PowerShell or similar tools. 
Monitor endpoint health, compliance posture, and fleet performance using telemetry and reporting, proactively remediating issues before they impact end users. 
Support BYOD and corporate device programs, including enrollment, conditional access enforcement, and data separation policies via Intune App Protection Policies (APP). 



Identity & Access (Endpoint Focus)


Administer Conditional Access policies, RBAC, and compliance enforcement via Microsoft Entra ID and Intune, ensuring devices meet security baselines before accessing corporate resources. 
Support joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle workflows from an endpoint provisioning and deprovisioning perspective, including Autopilot enrollment and device wipe/retire. 



Strategic Initiatives


Partner with network engineering, application, security, and business teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable, reliable endpoint solutions aligned with corporate objectives and enterprise architecture standards. 
Mentor junior engineers on endpoint management, device security, and automation best practices, and serve as a senior technical resource for project planning and high-priority escalations. 
Research and evaluate emerging technologies across endpoint management, VDI, and device security; present findings and strategic recommendations to leadership. 
Develop and maintain system documentation, runbooks, standard operating procedures, and engineering best practices. 



Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. 
7+ years of experience in systems engineering, enterprise environments, and endpoint platform administration. 
Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager for MDM/MAM, including device enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and app deployment across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. 
Hands-on experience with VDI platforms such as Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, or VMware Horizon, including image management, session hosting, and user profile optimization. 
3+ years of scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Python, or similar languages, including endpoint provisioning automation (Windows Autopilot, zero-touch deployment) and application management. 
Familiarity with endpoint security tooling including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, and Intune-enforced compliance and DLP policies. 
Strong working knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including GPO management, hybrid identity, and Conditional Access as applied to endpoint policy enforcement. 
Relevant certifications a plus: Microsoft 365 Certified (MD-102 Endpoint Administrator or Administrator Expert), Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty, Citrix CCA-V, or equivalent. 
Proficiency with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms and experience with cloud infrastructure, including Azure. 
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across endpoint hardware, OS, and management tooling. 
Proven track record of owning large-scale projects to successful delivery while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. 
Exceptional oral, written, and presentation skills, with a high degree of professionalism, thoroughness, and follow-up in communicating technical concepts in business terms to executives, vendors, contractors, and cross-functional teams. 



Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements

Regular, in-person attendance at the Lennar office during regular work hours is an essential function of this job. This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary. Some travel may be required for conferences and vendor engagements

Life at Lennar

At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits.

Join the fun and follow us on social media to see what's happening at our company, and don't forget to connect with us on Lennar: Overview | LinkedIn<https://www.linkedin.com/company/lennar/> for the latest job opportunities.

Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.

title: Internal IT Administrator
desc:
About NevadaNano

NevadaNano is an innovative technology company that provides safety and climate solutions for many of the world’s largest corporations using its proprietary Molecular Property Spectrometer™ (MPS™) multi-gas sensing platform. The company specializes in designing and manufacturing advanced gas detection products as well as continuous IoT monitoring systems.

About The Role

The Internal IT Administrator manages the organization’s day-to-day technology operations and is the primary point of contact with our Managed Service Provider (MSP). The role supports approximately 60 users across multiple locations, administers Microsoft 365 and endpoint management, supports our ERP and finance systems, and maintains IT security, policies, and documentation. The IT Administrator handles users, licenses, access administration and routine server tasks directly, and coordinates network and infrastructure changes through the MSP.

Key Responsibilities

End-User Support

Provide first-line technical support for hardware, software, printers, mobile devices, and business applications, escalating complex issues to the MSP
Assist with onboarding and offboarding employees, including account setup and equipment deployment.
Maintain IT asset inventory, including laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and peripherals.
Create and maintain user documentation and training materials.


Managed Service Provider Coordination

Serve as the primary liaison between the company and the MSP.
Open, track, and prioritize support tickets with the MSP.
Coordinate infrastructure projects, server upgrades, and maintenance activities.
Review MSP performance and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.


Microsoft 365 Administration

Administer Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Entra ID.
Manage users, shared mailboxes, distribution and security groups, licenses, and access.
Implement and maintain security policies, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Conditional Access.
Monitor license usage and recommend adjustments as needed.


Infrastructure and Server Administration

Hands on experience managing Windows and Linux Servers.
Monitor server health, performance, storage utilization, and backups, including backup verification.
Perform routine administrative tasks, including user account management, file share permissions, and Group Policy updates.
Maintain business continuity and disaster recovery documentation.


Security and Compliance

Enforce company IT security policies and standards.
Monitor endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and patch compliance.
Coordinate cybersecurity initiatives with the MSP.
Conduct periodic user access reviews.
Participate in incident response activities and investigations.


IT Governance and Policy Management

Develop and maintain IT policies, procedures, and standards.
Ensure compliance with company and industry requirements.
Manage software licensing and renewals.
Maintain technology documentation, including network diagrams and system procedures.
Assist leadership with technology planning and budgeting.


Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience: 3+ years in IT administration, systems administration, or a senior help desk role supporting a small to mid-sized organization.
Certifications (preferred): MD-102, MS-102, or SC-300; CompTIA A+, Network+, or Security+; or ITIL Foundation.
Technical knowledge: Working knowledge of Windows & Linux Servers, Active Directory, and basic networking (DNS, DHCP, VPN, VLANs, firewalls).
Business applications: Required experience supporting ERP or accounting systems (Microsoft Dynamics 365 or similar), including user access, permissions, and coordination with vendors or the finance team. Familiarity with financial reporting tools or month-end system needs is a plus.

EY advises clients on how to architect, migrate, and modernize their digital workplace using Microsoft 365 and the Power Platform. Our work spans strategy and technical architecture, solution delivery, and technical advisory services, with a strong emphasis on SharePoint modernization, large-scale content and workload migrations, and adoption of the Power Platform.

Role Summary

In this role, you will lead and deliver enterprise SharePoint Server (on-premises) to Microsoft 365 migrations and build modern SharePoint Online intranets. You will shape target information architecture, migration waves, and modernization approaches (including workflow/forms modernization to Power Platform), and you will partner closely with client stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and supportable solutions.

As a senior consultant, you will bring deep experience across SharePoint Server, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft 365 administration (including Entra ID, Teams, and OneDrive). You will lead and participate in full project lifecycles—discovery, assessment, target-state design, build/configuration, testing, migration execution, and deployment—and you will contribute to high-quality client outcomes through solution blueprints, design reviews, and cross-workstream collaboration.

As an M365 SharePoint Engineer, you will have in-depth knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management which enable you lead and participate in enterprise solution implementations, including all project phases such as discovery, definition, build, test and deploy. You will be an integral part of the delivery team to ensure the solutions built for our clients meet their needs to help drive their success through various methods such as solution blueprints, design reviews and cross-workstream collaborations to provide a total solution.

You will focus on the design, customization and optimization of digital workplace solutions, particularly with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and Power Platform. You will collaborate with various EY groups with digital capabilities to pursue and deliver digital engagements and deliver solutions that will bring our client’s digital vision, strategy and roadmap to life.

Key Responsibilities

You will focus primarily on (1) SharePoint on-premises to SharePoint Online migrations, (2) implementing modern SharePoint Online intranets, and (3) modernizing legacy customization patterns to the Power Platform. You will collaborate with internal EY teams and client stakeholders to shape and deliver complex enterprise engagements, balancing user experience, governance, and security/compliance requirements.

Assess & plan migrations: run discovery/inventory, define migration scope and waves, estimate effort/complexity, and establish cutover and hypercare plans.
Design the target intranet: define information architecture, hub/site strategy, navigation, search approach, metadata/content types, and permissions model.
Execute migrations: configure and operate Microsoft and third-party migration tooling, manage pilots, remediate issues, and drive successful cutovers.
Modernize solutions: map legacy workflows/forms (e.g., SharePoint Designer/InfoPath/Nintex/K2) to Power Automate and Power Apps patterns where appropriate.
Enable operations & governance: establish standards, provisioning/lifecycle controls, and operational reporting (including SharePoint Advanced Management where applicable).
Lead stakeholders: run workshops, produce client-ready deliverables, and communicate risks, tradeoffs, and decisions clearly to technical and business audiences.


Your experience with enterprise tenant-to-tenant migrations (M&A, divestitures, consolidations) and on-premises to cloud migrations will be critical to success in this role.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Delivering work across project phases (discovery, requirements, design, build, test, migration/cutover, and post-migration stabilization) with strong project governance and risk management.
Creating client-ready deliverables (assessments, target-state architectures, migration plans, runbooks, and executive communications) and contributing to reusable assets and accelerators.
Applying broad technical depth across SharePoint Server/Online, Microsoft 365 identity and collaboration services, and the Power Platform to solve real client problems.
Working effectively with client technologists and strategic partners/vendors to deliver an integrated solution.
Building trusted relationships with stakeholders through clear communication, practical recommendations, and reliable delivery.
Communicating effectively with client executives, product owners, business stakeholders, and engineering teams; translating requirements into actionable designs and plans.
Interacting and communicating effectively with teammates, clients, stakeholders, and executives


Qualifications (must-have)

3+ years of consulting experience delivering SharePoint solutions and/or migrations using Microsoft technologies.
Hands-on experience with SharePoint Server (2013/2016/2019) and SharePoint Online administration and configuration.
Proven experience planning and executing SharePoint migrations (assessment, waves, pilots, remediation, cutover, and hypercare).
Experience with at least one major migration toolset (e.g., Microsoft Migration Manager, ShareGate, AvePoint, Quest, or similar).
Experience implementing modern SharePoint Online intranets (IA, hubs, navigation, search, metadata, and permissions).
Working knowledge of the Power Platform (Power Apps and Power Automate), especially for forms/workflow modernization patterns.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; ability to lead workshops and present recommendations to technical and executive audiences.
Experience delivering in regulated or security-conscious environments, incorporating identity, governance, and compliance requirements into designs.
Prior enterprise consulting experience (client-facing delivery).

To qualify for the role, you must have

At least 2 years of professional enterprise technical consulting experience designing and implementing collaboration offerings leveraging the Microsoft stack including some or all of: Microsoft SharePoint Server, SharePoint Online, SharePoint Hybrid, and SharePoint administration. Candidate possesses a deep understanding of SharePoint migration process and tools (Migration Manager, Mover, etc.), SharePoint Server farm administration, SharePoint Online (and OneDrive and Teams) administration, solution packaging and deployment, troubleshooting. 
Working with enterprise clients to implement enterprise programs and possess a deep understanding and enterprise experience with some or all of:
SharePoint Server, SharePoint Online and OneDrive configuration, administration, and architecture
M365 platform governance and design – identity, security, and compliance
Power Platform integrations with SharePoint
SPO Content services with AI for SharePoint, Search, and Copilot enablement
Application Modernization programs - SharePoint Server On-Premises to SharePoint Online
Migration programs - mergers and acquisitions and divestiture programs, Cloud and digital workplace transformation programs
SharePoint enterprise governance with SharePoint Advanced Management or third-party tools like AvePoint
One or more of the following Microsoft certifications:

Microsoft Certified: AI Agent Builder Associate (beta)


Additional Qualifications (nice-to-have)

Microsoft certifications (preferred), such as Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, Teams Administrator Associate, and Security Administrator Associate.
Experience modernizing legacy workflows/forms using SharePoint Designer, InfoPath, Nintex, K2, or similar platforms.
Experience with additional migration and modernization tools (e.g., BitTitan, SkySync, Metalogix, or similar).


What We Look For

We’re looking for leaders who combine strong Microsoft 365/SharePoint technical depth with practical consulting skills—people who can assess complex environments, make clear recommendations, and deliver outcomes. title: Sr. Integration Engineer, Microsoft 365 (USI9)
desc:
Summary

The Sr. Integration Engineer, Microsoft 365 is responsible for leading the planning and execution of Microsoft 365 and related cloud service integrations for newly acquired companies into the VSE enterprise environment. This role owns the integration through lifecycle from tenant assessment and readiness planning through migration, cutover, validation, and post-implementation support.

Serving as the technical lead for assigned integrations, this highly hands-on senior individual contributor works directly with acquired-company stakeholders, internal IT teams, business leaders, and third-party vendors to develop migration strategies, manage risks and dependencies, coordinate activities, drive integration to successful completion. The position is field-based: travel to acquisition both domestic and international sites is required approximately 80% of the time, including overnight, weekend, and on-call coverage during go-live and hyper care periods.

Duties & Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Own and drive the Microsoft 365 integration lifecycle for assigned acquisitions from assessment and planning through migration, cutover, validation, and post-implementation support.
Lead Microsoft 365 and Azure tenant assessments, evaluating Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams, identity, domains, licensing, applications, and technical dependencies.
Develop and manage integration plans, migration strategies, schedules, dependencies, risks, remediation activities, cutover plans, and success criteria.
Plan and execute Exchange Online tenant-to-tenant migrations using BitTitan MigrationWiz or similar tools, including mailbox migration, domain transition, mail flow, and post-migration validation.
Plan and execute OneDrive, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, and applicable file-share migrations using ShareGate or similar tools.
Support Microsoft Entra ID and Azure tenant integration and develop PowerShell automation for assessments, data collection, migration preparation, validation, and reporting.
Lead migration testing, production cutovers, issue resolution, validation, and post-migration hypercare while minimizing business disruption.
Serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned integrations, coordinating stakeholders, managing risks and dependencies, communicating status and issues, and maintaining required integration documentation.
Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Requirements 

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field
Or an additional 3 years of specific work experience in lieu of a degree 
7+ years of progressive experience supporting Microsoft 365, cloud services, systems engineering, or similar enterprise technology environments.
Demonstrated experience leading complex Microsoft 365 migrations or integration initiatives from assessment and planning through cutover and post-migration support.
Hands-on experience administering and migrating Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft Teams.
Experience with Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migration tools such as BitTitan MigrationWiz, ShareGate, or similar technologies.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, Active Directory, and identity and application integrations using SAML, OIDC, OAuth, and SCIM.
Experience with DNS and domain management, including domain registrars, DNS records, domain verification, and domain transitions supporting Microsoft 365 and application integrations.
Proficiency with PowerShell for Microsoft 365 administration, automation, assessments, reporting, and migration activities.
Demonstrated ability to independently develop technical plans, manage risks and dependencies, coordinate stakeholders, communicate effectively with technical and business teams, and drive complex integrations to completion.
Ability and willingness to travel approximately 50% domestically and internationally and work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as required for migration cutovers and post-migration support.

Preferred Requirements

Microsoft 365, Azure, or other relevant Microsoft certifications.
Experience leading Microsoft 365 integrations for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or organizational consolidations.
Advanced experience with Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations, including Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Entra ID.
Experience with migration platforms such as BitTitan MigrationWiz, ShareGate, or comparable technologies.
Experience with Microsoft 365 domain transitions, mail routing, identity integration, permissions, licensing, and application dependencies.
Experience developing PowerShell automation for Microsoft 365 and Azure assessments, migrations, validation, and reporting.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex migration cutovers, make independent technical decisions, solve problems, and drive integrations to successful completion.


Other

80% of travel required.
The selected applicant will be subject to a background check and drug testing.

title: Systems Engineer - Practice Operations
desc:
Company Description

Integrated Dermatology is a leading national dermatology practice that acquires and partners with dermatology practices across the United States. The culture at ID is a reflection of its people. Our environment is filled with hard-working, dynamic individuals who come together to ensure the success of our partner dermatologists.

Position Summary

The Systems Engineer, Practice Operations leads the technical assessment, planning, remediation, implementation, and validation work required to transition acquired and existing practices to Integrated Dermatology standards.

This position serves as the subject matter expert for SonicWall firewalls, Ubiquiti networking, practice connectivity, and site infrastructure. The Systems Engineer works directly with practice leadership, internal teams, carriers, vendors, cabling providers, and managed service providers to deliver standardized, secure, supportable practice environments. The position also leads Microsoft 365 tenant and data migrations associated with practice acquisitions and integrations.

Job Description

Lead technical discovery, due diligence, planning, implementation, validation, and post-transition stabilization for practice acquisitions, onboarding projects, and technology transitions. 
Lead and coordinate technical workstreams associated with practice acquisitions, facility relocations, network upgrades, Microsoft 365 migrations, and infrastructure modernization initiatives. 
Conduct onsite and remote assessments of practice environments, including Microsoft 365, internet connectivity, firewalls, switches, wireless access points, VPNs, servers, endpoints, voice services, cabling, security controls, and application dependencies. 
Develop and execute prioritized remediation plans that align acquired and existing practices with Integrated Dermatology network, security, Microsoft 365, endpoint, infrastructure, and documentation standards.

title: AI Adoption & Governance Manager
desc:
Hybrid - In-person (3 days in office)

Want to shape how an employee-owned engineering firm adopts AI? As Hazen’s AI Adoption & Governance Manager, you will lead the effort to make AI part of how every office and practice group works, with direct access to IT leadership and the authority to move quickly. If you are highly motivated, adaptable and energized by fast-moving technology, Hazen may be the place for you.

This position, which reports directly to the Director of Information Technology, leads the day-to-day support, adoption and governance of the firm’s AI tools: enterprise assistants like Copilot and Claude, AI features inside engineering and design software, and internal automations. Serves as the link between IT, project teams and leadership, so that staff use AI tools productively, safely and within firm policy.

This position will partner closely with senior members of the IT team and Design Technology, building on existing workflows and system requirements to shape how AI is supported across the firm. Candidates must work well in a team environment, be able to effectively prioritize and execute tasks, and be willing to learn and develop new skills that support the responsibilities outlined below. Because AI tools and the way Hazen uses them are changing quickly, the right person is nimble and responsive: able to reprioritize quickly, resolve issues as they arise, and adapt the support model as new tools and needs emerge.

Within the first year, AI is part of how nearly everyone at Hazen works. Staff in every office and practice group use approved AI tools confidently, productively and safely, and the support, training and governance model keeps pace as the tools evolve.

Why Hazen And Sawyer

Founded in 1951 by the son of Allen Hazen (developer of the Hazen-Williams equation), we are an employee-owned company with a singular focus on "all things water."
Our work includes planning, design, and oversight of construction of environmental infrastructure – for water, wastewater, and stormwater management.
We foster a work environment low on bureaucracy and high in creativity.
We recruit talented professionals, provide them with challenging, interesting, and creative assignments, and furnish them with the tools they need to succeed.
We currently have over 2,000 employees in 70+ offices throughout the United States, Latin America, Canada, and the UK.
A flexible hybrid work schedule supports today's busy professionals.


Key Responsibilities Will Include, But Not Be Limited To

Own the support model for enterprise AI tools: intake, triage, escalation paths, knowledge base and service levels, in coordination with the Helpdesk Manager.
Administer AI platforms: licensing, user provisioning, connectors and integrations, usage monitoring and cost tracking.
Approve AI tools, pilots, integrations and configuration changes within firm policy, with the authority to act quickly and escalate to the Director of Information Technology only when risk, cost or a policy exception requires it.
Run adoption and training: onboarding sessions, prompt libraries, office hours and a champions network across offices and practice groups.
Partner with Design Technology on AI in engineering workflows (BIM/CAD, GIS, modeling, document production) and on evaluating new tools.
Monitor new AI tools and features, including Copilot, Claude and AI in engineering software, assess their impact and opportunity, and adapt the support model and guidance as the technology evolves.
Administer and uphold AI governance in partnership with the Director of Information Technology: the firm’s AI acceptable-use policy and its ongoing refinement, data classification (client confidentiality, CUI/ITAR where it applies), vendor security reviews, and records retention for AI outputs.
Collect use cases from the business, prioritize them, and pilot automations or agents that deliver clear, practical value to project teams and the business.
Report to IT leadership on how AI tools are being used, what is working, and where risks and opportunities exist.
Supervise or mentor AI support analysts and coordinate with external vendors.
Occasional travel may be required.


Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent experience.
7+ years in IT support, systems administration or digital enablement, including 3+ years leading people or programs, with a record of driving technology adoption or organizational change.
Hands-on administration of enterprise AI platforms (Copilot, Claude or similar) and M365 tools (Entra ID, Purview, SharePoint/Teams).
Working knowledge of LLM concepts, prompt design, data privacy and AI risk frameworks such as NIST AI RMF.
Strong training and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical limits to non-technical staff.
Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-changing environment: responsive, adaptable and comfortable reprioritizing quickly as needs shift.


Preferred Qualifications

AEC or engineering industry experience.
ITIL certification.
Scripting or low-code skills (Power Automate, Python).


What We Offer

Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision, and prescription plans).
Pre-tax flexible spending plans for medical, dependent care, and transportation.
Short and long-term disability, and employer paid life insurance.
Paid holidays, floating holidays, and paid time off (PTO).
Employer-contributed 401(k) plan and additional financial planning support.
Professional growth opportunities, including tuition reimbursement, in-house training, and incentives for professional registration and professional organization memberships.
Starting pay range for this position depends on skills, experience, education and geographical location.

title: Senior Endpoint Engineer
desc:
Senior Endpoint Engineer

Hybrid in Washington, DC — on site at least 2 days per week

The Senior Endpoint Engineer defines the target state for how a federal agency's devices are provisioned, managed, secured and supported, and leads the engineering work to get there. The central mission is modernization: moving the fleet from a ConfigMgr-centric, on-premises model to a cloud-native model built on Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Windows Autopilot and Windows Autopatch, aligned to federal Zero Trust requirements. You own the roadmap, the design decisions and the reference standards for that transition while staying hands-on with ConfigMgr, Intune, Dell enterprise tooling and BeyondTrust. This is an individual-contributor role with no supervisory duties; it leads through technical direction. Work is tracked in ServiceNow and Azure DevOps (ADO) Boards.

Endpoint Architecture and Strategy:


Define and maintain the endpoint target-state architecture across identity, provisioning, configuration, application delivery, update management, security and support tooling.

Own the multi-year endpoint modernization roadmap, with phases, dependencies, entry and exit criteria, and risk for each phase.

Produce architecture artifacts: current- and target-state diagrams, design documents, architecture decision records (ADRs) and reference configurations.

Evaluate new Microsoft and vendor capabilities, run proofs of concept, and recommend adoption, deferral or retirement with cost, risk and effort analysis.

Define the user persona model and set endpoint engineering standards for naming, policy design, assignment and filtering, app packaging and baseline management.

Advise program leadership on endpoint risk, technical debt, licensing and investment priorities.


Modernization Delivery:


Lead the transition from ConfigMgr to Intune, moving co-management workloads in planned waves with pilot groups and defined success criteria.

Drive the move from hybrid join toward Entra ID join and zero-touch provisioning with Windows Autopilot.

Modernize update management with Windows Update for Business and Windows Autopatch, including ring design and driver and firmware update policy.

Move application delivery to Intune Win32 apps and catalog-based app management, and retire legacy packages.

Replace on-premises dependencies with cloud services where approved, such as Windows LAPS, cloud-based certificate delivery and Intune Remediations.

Plan the reduction and eventual decommissioning of ConfigMgr infrastructure.

Coordinate cutovers with imaging, identity, network, security and service desk teams, with tested rollback plans for each wave.

Act as senior escalation point for ConfigMgr, Intune, co-management, Autopilot and Windows 11 client issues.


Security, Automation and Leadership:


Design endpoint security configuration to meet NIST SP 800-53 controls, Microsoft security baselines and applicable DISA STIG or CIS benchmarks.

Define device compliance signals for Entra Conditional Access in partnership with the identity and security teams.

Build automation in PowerShell and the Microsoft Graph API for provisioning, configuration, compliance checks and reporting.

Develop KQL and SQL queries and dashboards (SSRS, Power BI, or Intune and Endpoint Analytics reports), and report modernization metrics.

Author and present Change Advisory Board (CAB) requests for architecture-level and high-risk changes, and review other engineers' changes.

Plan roadmap work in ADO Boards linked to ServiceNow records; write SOPs, runbooks and knowledge articles.

Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing and walkthroughs.


Requirements:


Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or 12+ years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.

8+ years of enterprise Windows endpoint management experience, including 2+ years leading the design of significant endpoint initiatives.

Hands-on experience with both ConfigMgr and Microsoft Intune, including co-management, having moved at least one workload or device population from ConfigMgr to Intune.

Has designed and deployed Windows Autopilot for production users in at least one deployment mode.

PowerShell scripting for automation; able to read and adapt scripts that use the Microsoft Graph API.

Clear writing of design documents, diagrams and SOPs that other engineers can carry out.

Experience with incidents, problems and change requests in ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM tool.

CompTIA Security+ held at start or earned within 90 days.

On site in Washington, DC at least 2 days per week.

US Citizenship (no dual citizenship) and the ability to pass a federal background investigation in order to be granted access to sensitive information.


Preferred:


Windows Update for Business or Windows Autopatch, Intune Remediations and Endpoint Analytics.

Working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access and device compliance in a Zero Trust model.

SQL and KQL for querying ConfigMgr, Intune and endpoint telemetry data.

Endpoint work in a federal environment under FISMA, NIST SP 800-53 and CISA directives, including Microsoft government cloud.

Dell enterprise tooling (Dell Command | Update, Dell Command | Configure, BIOS and Secure Boot management).

BeyondTrust or a comparable privileged access or remote support platform; Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Windows LAPS or Azure DevOps Boards.

Certifications such as Microsoft MD-102, MS-102, SC-300 or ITIL 4 Foundation.


Compensation: $150,000 - $175,000 per year
